services.name: Fly Fishing
services.desc: One of southern Vermont’s oldest ice fishing guide services. Beginners are welcome. All ages and abilities are welcome. Trips are 3-4 hours with a heated shelter on cold days. All the fishing equipment is provided and the guide drills all the holes. Over 15 years old, a fishing license is required and must purchased day before the trip online. Ice conditions dictate whether we fish or not. Safety is the number one priority at Vermont fishing trips. Trips are catch and release unless other prior arrangements have been made. BogaGrips are used to ensure clean releases & to allow for photographs that will last forever. VT ice fishing guides will drill the holes with a Strike Master 24V Lithium

includes: All fishing gear, tackle, waders, and flies included
Orvis fly rod reel and stocking foot waders with felt bottom wading shoes
All trout flies, terminal tackle, strike indicators, and leaders
Ice fishing gear including Strike Master 24V Lithium 6” Ice Auger, tipups, bait
Portable two person Clam Nanook XL Thermal flip over shelter with Mr. Heater Big Buddy propane heater
gap: Price per trip or per person not stated
blurb: Vermont Fishing Trips offers private 4-hour half-day guided fly fishing trips on trout rivers in spring, summer, and fall, and ice fishing trips in winter months on lakes for Northern Pike, Bass, and other species. All fishing gear, tackle, waders, and flies are included in the daily guiding rate. Beginners are welcome and personalized coaching is provided.
extraNote: Year round; fly fishing April through October, ice fishing January through March
